format: Input maxLength conformance vectors. Core (Input.test.ts) and Rust (tests/widgets.rs) run this file. A row is [name, value, maxLength, select, insert, expected, issue?].
The input gets value and maxLength in each order the binding allows, Shift+Left selects `select` characters left of the end, and insert replaces the selection. expected is the value it holds.
maxLength counts UTF-16 code units. A cut never splits a character: a character that does not fit whole is left out.
rows: an insert into a full value
a CJK character counts one unit
an emoji across the limit after a CJK character
an inserted emoji with one unit of room
an inserted emoji with two units of room
a selected emoji frees two units
